claim_decisions.statement: Source dated 2025-01-15 reports: Estimated: 16% exposed to extreme drought, 7% to extreme floods; poor households face 1.4x drought exposure. Drought affects all islands (lower in São Vicente/Sal); 90% of flood exposure is in Santiago/Santo Antão.

claim_decisions.statement: Source dated 2025-01-15 reports: The CCDR identifies 143,000 people (28%) in poverty/food-insecurity hotspots; six municipalities have acute food insecurity of at least 15%, five on Santiago and one on Santo Antão.

claim_decisions.statement: Source dated 2025-01-15 reports: RCP 8.5 projections raise coastal-flood exposure from 29% of coastal residents now to about 32% by 2050; Sal's exposed urban coast could rise from 33% to over 38%.

claim_decisions.statement: Source dated 2025-01-15 reports: The CCDR identifies drought and tourism as rural-to-urban migration drivers, especially toward Sal and Boa Vista.
claim_decisions.uncertainty: Drought and tourism are described as mobility drivers, not a causal estimate or evidence that migration produces violence.

claim_decisions.statement: Source dated 2025-10-22 reports: The IFRC update reports at least 12 deaths, five missing, over 27,500 affected and 1,500 displaced in São Vicente after floods and landslides, with damage to homes, roads, health services, markets and water systems.
claim_decisions.uncertainty: Dated 2025 flood displacement/loss estimates, not in themselves a climate-FCV mechanism or current caseload.

claim_decisions.statement: WMO's December 2025 update reports an Early Warnings for All launch and draft five-year roadmap; validation and implementation were then expected during 2026.
claim_decisions.uncertainty: No later validation, implementation, operational reach or warning effectiveness was verified in this review.

claim_decisions.statement: Source dated not stated reports: UNDP's completed-project page describes pilots across three municipalities and five basins, including groundwater intake and drip irrigation in Ribeira Seca and planned reforestation/soil conservation at Planalto Leste on Santo Antão.
claim_decisions.uncertainty: Completed-project webpage mixes pilot design and reported completion. Specific works and durable water or livelihood benefits are not independently verified.

gaps: Collector reports direct full-PDF CCDR and IFRC inspection. Coordinator's independent CCDR fetch hit reader size/HTTP403 limits and IFRC returned octet-stream; these remain explicit human-approval checks.

executive_assessment.text: Santiago/Santo Antão modelled flood exposure, Sal's coastal scenarios and dated São Vicente flood impacts add differentiated island evidence.
Reported emergency water transport, named water-sector pilots and warning-roadmap milestones deepen capacity, with planned actions distinguished from measured outcomes.
